last_result.reason: Approved: the loitering rule now records per-track center-path trajectory, rejects persistent stationary-object tracks, and preserves dwell across brief tracker dropouts, with 8 new regression tests; deterministic gates pass, guardian and evaluator both approve, and no accuracy claim is made because model weights and labelled loitering clips are missing.

current.goal: Improve crowd anomaly detection using per-zone density and motion baselines instead of raw person count.
